title: 礼貌拒绝邀请，不让关系变尴尬
subtitle: Saying no politely and offering another option

audio.title: How to turn down an invitation
audio.note: 视频完整时长 1分13秒，今天听完整段。已实际检索并打开官方页面，核对页面元数据时长及匹配 Transcript；自动化浏览器未能推进媒体流，因此不声称已完成播放验证。先不要看字幕或文字稿；完整 Transcript 在来源页说明/文字稿中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕听力｜先抓拒绝的原因和办法（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开来源页，听完整 1分13秒，第一遍关闭字幕，也先不要看 Transcript。

第一遍：不中断，只判断两个人为什么不想参加活动。
第二遍：只记 invitation、party、reply、truth、prior engagement 等关键词；漏词也继续，不要逐词翻译。
第三遍：完成两道主旨题，再估计第一次无字幕听懂比例。答完后才能进入精听。第三方原文只短提示一句：‘I'm unable to attend because I have a prior engagement.’
questions: 两个人为什么在讨论如何回复？A. 收到不想参加的聚会邀请 B. 忘了聚会地址 C. 想邀请别人吃饭
他们最后选择怎样礼貌拒绝？A. 直接说对方很无聊 B. 说自己已有安排 C. 不回复
sections.answers:
1. A。他们收到一个不想参加的正式聚会邀请。
2. B。最后使用 prior engagement，表示自己已有安排。

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
把 1分13秒视频再听两遍。每处按“先听 → 暂停模仿两次 → 看提示 → 关文本重听”练习。

① But I don't want to go.｜don't want to 中 want to 常连得接近 /wɒnə/，重音落在 don't、want、go。
② What can I say?｜can 常弱读 /kən/，what_can 连成一个意群。
③ I'm unable to attend.｜to 常弱读 /tə/；unable_to 会自然连接，重音落在 unable、attend。

最后关掉全部文字，重听完整段并跟读一轮。先模仿意群和重音，再尝试用自己的理由替换 prior engagement。
questions: want to 在自然语流中可能连得接近什么？
I'm unable to attend 中哪个词通常弱读？

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜拒绝周五晚餐，也给出下一步（4分钟）
sections.body: Ella's new colleague Ben invited her to dinner with a few friends on Friday. Ella wanted to know them better, but she had already promised to help her sister move house that evening. At first, she planned to write only, “Sorry, I can't come.” Then she worried that the message sounded cold. She thanked Ben for the invitation, gave a short honest reason and suggested another time. Her final message said, “Thanks for inviting me. I'd love to, but I'm helping my sister on Friday. Could I join you next time?” Ben replied that he understood and invited her for coffee the following week. Ella did not invent a complicated excuse or explain every detail. Her answer was warm, clear and brief. By showing interest in a future plan, she refused one invitation without rejecting the friendship. She also learned that a polite no does not need to become a long apology.
questions: Why could Ella not go to dinner on Friday?
What three things made her final reply polite?
sections.translation: 艾拉的新同事本邀请她周五和几位朋友一起吃晚餐。艾拉想更好地认识他们，但她已经答应那天晚上帮姐姐搬家。起初，她只想写：“抱歉，我来不了。”随后她担心这条消息显得冷淡。她感谢本的邀请，简短而诚实地说明原因，并建议改天再约。她最后写道：“谢谢邀请。我很想去，但周五要帮姐姐。下次我可以参加吗？”本回复说他理解，并邀请她下周一起喝咖啡。艾拉没有编一个复杂的借口，也没有解释所有细节。她的回答温暖、清楚而简短。通过表达对未来安排的兴趣，她拒绝了一次邀请，却没有拒绝这段友谊。她也明白了，礼貌说不并不需要变成长篇道歉。
sections.answers:
1. She had already promised to help her sister move house.
2. She thanked Ben, gave a short reason and suggested another time.

sections.title: 4. 高频词块｜温和但清楚地说不（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Thanks for inviting me.｜谢谢你邀请我。｜Thanks for inviting me to dinner. 谢谢你邀请我吃晚餐。
2. I'd love to, but ...｜我很想去，但是……｜I'd love to, but I'm working late. 我很想去，但我要工作到很晚。
3. I'm afraid I can't make it.｜恐怕我来不了。｜I'm afraid I can't make it on Friday. 恐怕周五我来不了。
4. I already have plans.｜我已经有安排了。｜I already have plans that evening. 那天晚上我已经有安排了。
5. Maybe another time?｜要不改天？｜I can't stay today. Maybe another time? 我今天不能留下，要不改天？
6. How about next weekend?｜下周末怎么样？｜How about next weekend instead? 改到下周末怎么样？
7. Thanks for understanding.｜谢谢你理解。｜Thanks for understanding. I hope you have fun. 谢谢你理解，祝你玩得开心。
8. turn down｜拒绝｜She turned down the invitation politely. 她礼貌地拒绝了邀请。
9. alternative｜替代选择｜Let's offer an alternative date. 我们提出另一个日期吧。
sections.answers: 优先记住 7 个词块：Thanks for inviting me. / I'd love to, but ... / I'm afraid I can't make it. / I already have plans. / Maybe another time? / How about next weekend? / Thanks for understanding.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜用 I'd love to, but ... 缓和拒绝（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 I'd love to, but + 完整句子，先表达积极态度，再说明不能参加。I'd 是 I would 的缩写。也可用 I'm afraid + 完整句子，让拒绝听起来更委婉。

例句 1：I'd love to, but I already have plans. 我很想去，但我已经有安排了。
例句 2：I'm afraid I can't make it on Saturday. 恐怕我周六来不了。
questions: 填空：I'd love ___, but I'm busy on Friday.
把直接拒绝 No, I can't come. 改成含 I'm afraid 的委婉表达。
sections.answers:
1. to
2. I'm afraid I can't come.

sections.title: 6. 对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话
A: Would you like to join us for dinner on Friday?
B: Thanks for inviting me. I'd love to, but I already have plans.
A: No problem. Maybe another time?
B: Yes, please. How about next weekend?
A: Saturday works for me.
B: Great. Thanks for understanding.

替换练习
① dinner on Friday → a party on Saturday；have plans → have to work。
② next weekend → Tuesday evening；Saturday → Wednesday。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 朋友邀你今晚喝咖啡，但你要学习：I'd love to, but I have to study tonight.
2) 你不能参加周六聚会：I'm afraid I can't make it on Saturday.
3) 你想给出替代安排：Maybe another time. How about next weekend?

30–60 秒口头任务：礼貌拒绝朋友的晚餐邀请。先感谢，简短说明原因，再提出另一个日期。不要先逐句翻译中文。
sections.answers: 示例：Thanks for inviting me to dinner. I'd love to, but I'm helping my sister on Friday, so I'm afraid I can't make it. Maybe another time? How about next Saturday? Thanks for understanding.

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个同事交流词块：
1. What can I do to help?｜我能做什么来帮忙？
2. Please do this first.｜请先做这件事。
3. I'll do it today.｜我今天会完成。

快速串联：What can I do to help? Please tell me what to do first, and I'll do it today.

请回原聊天告诉我：① 今天第一次无字幕听懂了约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成礼貌拒绝任务。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个礼貌拒绝词块，并在 30–60 秒内完成“感谢＋拒绝理由＋替代安排”。
